name: bizmanager-root
description: BizManager Root project script runner (Developed by MegaTrix)

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
